text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... What lovely weather.
It's truly the perfect day for a hike.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today, everyone!
"If you eat too much soba, go shout Yahoo from a mountaintop"...
Thanks for playing along with my personal rule!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
No... please don't worry about it.
I'm sure it will be a good refresher.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm also thrilled to see
what kind of flowers we'll encounter. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Right... Everyone, if you'd like,
please take this mountaineering plan.
For safety, I've also filed it with the police...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you prepared this for me?!
As expected of Chrono-chan, you're a lifesaver~!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The date, time, emergency contacts, and the climbing route...
I feel bad having you prepare so much for me.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Phew! We've climbed quite a bit...
but the fresh air feels wonderful!
I feel like I could keep going for miles like this!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Wait a moment.
Bouquet-san, there's a scrape on your leg...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Please wait a moment. I have a first-aid kit
ready for basic first aid.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you even prepared first aid supplies—
I truly appreciate your thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, truly. Even I
often find myself relying on Chrono-chan, after all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"You know how I always keep raspberry drinks in stock for streaming?
She went out of her way to let me know I was running low!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I managed to restock before starting the stream, didn't I?
That was a real lifesaver back then.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Me too! When we did vocal training together, she marked all the tricky pitch parts for me! The lesson went super smoothly thanks to her♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all...
I'm just glad I could be of even a little help.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I want to reach the summit safely with everyone.
...Let's keep heading toward our destination like this.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: —Yoo-hoooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yay, I fulfilled my personal rule!
I worked up a good sweat, and feel totally refreshed~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"We arrived earlier than scheduled, didn't we?
After enjoying the scenery, heading to another spot might also—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Could this be...!!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm sorry.
While looking up this mountain area, I realized something... There's a shrine nearby that has deep ties to Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Huh, there's a shrine like that?
Could it be that you've been interested in it for a while now?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... It's a shrine with a deep history where Umamusume once performed sacred rituals.
Even today, people associated with Umamusume come to pray here.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
B-But... we came all this way for a hike today,
after all. ...Please don't worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I don't mind at all♪
I'd love to go visit that shrine with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure...?
Yes, if everyone is okay with it,
please allow me to show you around.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"This is that place...! There should be a shrine on these grounds
famous for prayers of victory for Umamusume.
Let us go pay our respects right away—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, please wait a moment.
Before that, how about some lunch?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"We haven't eaten yet, after all.
I thought that you might be hungry as well, Chrono-san."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm fine.
Please, everyone, go on ahead without me!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I can eat leisurely later.
I'd rather spend as much time as possible exploring the shrine—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Aha. Your passion is wonderful,
but your stomach seems to be totally empty.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Then let's eat our boxed lunches at a nearby park!
I made mine specially for hiking~☆

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm sorry...
Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed near the dorms,
I spotted Chrono Genesis and the others.
choice_data_list: What's everyone doing up this late at night?
What is everyone doing out this late at night?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu, well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“—This is the shrine where Umamusume once raced
as a sacred ritual praying for a bountiful harvest.
To think it's right before my very eyes...”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Chrono-chan got so absorbed in gathering historical documents that she barely made it back before the dorm curfew."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I apologize for the trouble I've caused...
I'm terribly embarrassed...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, please don't worry about it.
We all know just how much you love racing, Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you're always taking care of me!
This is the least I can do☆

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...
Th-Thank you all so, so much...!
choice_data_list: It's precisely because Chrono is so reliable.
It's precisely because Chrono is so reliable, isn't it?
Did you have fun at the shrine with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...
Th-Thank you all so, so much...!
choice_data_list: It's precisely because Chrono is so reliable.
It's precisely because Chrono is so reliable, isn't it?
Did you have fun at the shrine with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I'm still quite inexperienced.
Even this time, I got so absorbed that I lost
sight of my surroundings...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I think it's great, though!
Chrono-chan getting totally absorbed in racing is super lovely too♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, very much so.
Everyone seemed so interested...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"It's because Chrono-chan told me so much about shrines!
That's why I prayed a whole bunch♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I would love to join you again.
...With everyone from our generation, someday.
